text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Knock knock. —Yoo-hoo, it's your super-duper cute
partner Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainy, do you know what day today is~?
choice_data_list: Um, Valentine's?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Valentine's Day. Otherwise known as—
the day you get chocolates from everyone~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: So with that said, Trainy! Let's go get us some chocolate together~!
choice_data_list: Is that what Valentine's Day is supposed to be?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Giving it to that special someone is the standard, sure. But there are also some super sweet girls who make tons of them for everyone~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And I've already scoped out all the details on that.
Come on, hurry up or we're gonna miss the boat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here you go~. It's Hishi Akebono's special, super-buono milk chocolate~☆

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, sho yum-mee.
My mouf is fwoo of haffiness~.
choice_data_list: Aren't you stuffing way too much in your mouth at once?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Ahaha, oops.
I got a little carried away.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for this every year, Akebono-chan.
Both its size and taste are top-notch~. Absolutely the best.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: No, thank you! It only turned out this delicious because you gave me all those tips, Tran-san☆
choice_data_list: Tran...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! They told me about a shop
that has delicious cacao~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"You always give me such delicious chocolate,
so doing this much is only natural, right?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Trainer-chan, why don't you try some too~?
It's so yummy you won't be able to stop stuffing your face.
choice_data_list: Huh, me too?
Huh, is it okay if I join too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course～☆
Here you go～!

Having received chocolates from Hishi Akebono,
I promptly took a bite—
choice_data_list: *nom nom*... Dish is shoo tashty!
*nom nom*... Dish is shoo tashty, yesh!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, of course it'd turn out like that~.
Or rather, isn't that just proper etiquette?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh, this is amazing~! Chiyono O-chan...
This nerikiri is ridiculously good, you know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"It's shaped like a cherry blossom, so cute! I can totally tell how much time
and effort you put into it. Thank youuu!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It's all thanks to you
giving us info on that rare sugar, Tran-san!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, Trainer-chan.
Isn't the nerikiri you got
a bit bigger? Isn't that totally unfair?
choice_data_list: Huh, I don't really think it's that different, though.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...All right. Shall we do the trade then~?
choice_data_list: No, no! You already took a bite!
No, no! You already took a bite!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. No need to be so uptight.
It's better for both of us this way, right?
choice_data_list: There's nothing in this for us, though!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Tran-san and her Trainer seem to get along so well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Daikon radish stewed in the very same pot"—how truly enviable!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, you think so? Isn't it pretty normal, though?
...It is normal, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think it's normal, though...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Being able to bicker like that
is proof of how close you two are!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Help yourself to Windy-chan's super delicious
chocolate! ...Heh-heh-heh."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you sure I can have all this? Aren't you being way too generous?
Thanks a bunch, Windy-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Alrighty, Trainer-chan.
Let's have a contest to see who can eat the spiciest food~

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? How come?!
When did you figure out it had extra-spicy in it?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Aha. I've already investigated all about that~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, Tre-chan and I are gonna do Russian Chocolate.
Be our witness, 'kay~?
choice_data_list: Um... nobody said anything about a competition, though?
Hey... no one said anything about a match?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What's this~? Could it be that Trai-chan
doesn't have the confidence to beat me~?
choice_data_list: ...I didn't say I wouldn't do it!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi. I kinda like
that about you, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guh... T-this isn't quite what I had in mind!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go first.
Here goes—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
……All right, safe.
The dud still tastes pretty good, actually.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, naturally! If it were only super spicy,
no one would take any!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I totally learned from last year's mistake!
How's that! Windy-chan is super smart, see!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see, I see~.
Alright, Trai-chan, you're up next!

I accept the chocolate from Transcend and
pop a piece into my mouth. ...Mmm, delicious!
choice_data_list: Alright, heave— ngh, gwaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! You totally fell for it! Now writhe in spicy agony!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Huh~, is it really that spicy?
Aren't you exaggerating~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let me see, I'll take a—
...Ah, oh crap...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: W-Water! Where is it, waterrr!
choice_data_list: *Gulp gulp gulp...*

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hand it over~!
What's Trainy's water is my water~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was fun, wasn't it?
Our journey to receive Valentine's chocolates.
choice_data_list: Ah, that was so much fun!
Yeah, that was so much fun!

text_block_list.text:
Getting delicious chocolate was great, but more than anything,
I was happy to have spent such a fun time with Transcend.
choice_data_list: Thanks for inviting me.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Fufu... But it's not over yet, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: So yeah, here you go.
choice_data_list: Huh... You got this ready for me!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mm. Go ahead and open it.

Following her suggestion, I open the chocolate wrapping.
Inside is an assortment of chocolate treats
that she, a chocolate lover, seemingly handpicked.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Every single one is part of our starting lineup,
so savor each bite~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's eat together~.
Get me a hot coffee, please~.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll get it ready!
Yeah, I'll get it ready!

text_block_list.text:
And so, we spent a Valentine's Day that felt just
like any other, yet was somehow a little special.

Following her suggestion, I open the chocolate wrapping.
Inside—is a heart-shaped chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, why don't you take a bite?

Following her advice, I took a small bite from the edge of the chocolate.
...It wasn't just sweet; there was a sharp spicy kick along with a distinct blend of aromatic spices. It was delicious!
choice_data_list: Did you put spices in this?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Correct. There's plenty of sweet stuff with spices lately,
so I thought it'd suit a mature Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...How is it? Does it suit your taste?

I nod vigorously to Transcend's question.
It was a chocolate fitting for someone as well-informed as her.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I mean, oh yeah.
I forgot to mention it, so I might as well say it now.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's, Trai-chan.
—I'm always grateful for you.
